map.「基于历史月度销售数据，使用移动平均、加权移动平均、线性回归或季节性方法预测未来: Forecasts future sales from historical monthly data using moving average, weighted moving average, linear regression, or seasonal methods, and computes and outputs results from the input parameters.
map.历史销售数据（每行一个数值，按时间顺序，至少 3 期）: Historical sales data (one value per line, in time order, at least 3 periods)
map.取最近 N 期算术平均作为下期预测: Use the arithmetic mean of the last N periods as the next-period forecast
map.近期权重更高（权重 N,N-1,...,1）: Higher weight on recent periods (weights N,N-1,...,1)
map.按同期环比增长率外推（需至少一个周期）: Extrapolate by same-period growth rate (needs at least one cycle)
map.基于历史残差标准差的近似 95% 置信区间（预测值 ± 1.96σ）。仅作参考，: Approximate 95% confidence interval from historical residual standard deviation (forecast ± 1.96σ). For reference only; actual forecast error is affected by many factors.
map.移动平均预测：用近 N 期均值外推未来，适合平稳无强趋势的序列。: Moving-average forecast: extrapolate from the mean of the last N periods, suitable for stationary series with no strong trend.
map.预测：拟合历史趋势线 y=a+bx，外推未来，适合持续增长/下滑序列。: Forecast: fit the historical trend line y=a+bx and extrapolate, suitable for sustained growth/decline series.
map.季节性预测：按周期长度用同比环比增长率外推，适合月度/季度强周期业务。: Seasonal forecast: extrapolate by cycle-length YoY/MoM growth rate, suitable for monthly/quarterly strongly cyclical business.
map.举例：序列 [100,120,110,130,140]，移动平均 N=3 预测: Example: series [100,120,110,130,140], moving average N=3 forecasting 2 periods
map.第1期预测 = 最近3期均值 (110+130+140)/3 = 126.67；:
Period 1 forecast = mean of last 3 (110+130+140)/3 = 126.67; add it to the series then forecast period 2 = (130+140+126.67)/3 ≈ 132.22.
With linear regression, fit the trend then extrapolate periods 6 and 7 (x=6,7), better for monotonic trends; the seasonal pattern extrapolates by the 'same period last year → this year' growth rate.

map.置信区间怎么理解？: How to interpret the confidence interval?
map.σ 给出 ±1.96σ 区间，表示约 95% 可能落在该范围。σ 越大、历史越波: σ to give a ±1.96σ interval, meaning about 95% probability falls in this range. The larger σ and the more volatile history, the wider the interval and the less reliable the forecast; judge with business context.
